title: Cadet-Agent Session State
description: Tracks workflow progress across a session. v2 added evidence-backed gates, the active run/work item, and legal transition metadata. v3 added strict closure, manual-confirmation quality fields, and a gate-exception taxonomy (opt-in via `strictClosure.enabled`). v4 moves evidence history out of this document: `gateEvidence` keeps only the active work item, `evidenceCoverage` indexes what left, gate exceptions get their own field, and `changeHistory` is retired — history lives in commit trailers (see gitmemo.mjs / HarnessContract-v5.md) and `.cadet/archive/`. v1-v3 documents remain readable and are migrated by `cadet-agent state migrate --to 4`.

gateException.description: A scoped, expiring exception that permits a gate to be treated as satisfied without fresh evidence. Live state, not history: it is bounded by `expiresAt` and read by `activeExceptions`.

scope.description: The work item id(s) this exception covers. An exception scoped to another work item never excuses the active one.

category.description: v3: required on a gate-exception under strictClosure. Determines the default expiry window and whether closureReviewNote is required. The set must match EXCEPTION_CATEGORIES in policy.mjs.

reason.description: v3: why the exception was needed. Strict closure only.

closureReviewNote.description: v3: who accepted this exception and what would change that judgement. Required for categories that are not documentation-only. Strict closure only.

expiryExtendedReason.description: v3: required when the exception expires beyond its category default.

evidenceCoverageRow.description: v4: what survives compaction for one work item. It is what keeps the 'a done story owns evidence' check answerable once the records themselves have been archived or sealed into commits.

sealedCommit.description: The commit whose trailers carry this work item's evidence, or null when it was archived rather than sealed.

version.description: Schema version. v1 is gate-only; v2 adds gateEvidence, activeRunId, activeWorkItem, and lastTransition. v3 adds strict closure, manual-confirmation quality fields, and a gate-exception taxonomy — all opt-in via `strictClosure.enabled`, so a v2 document remains valid and is not retroactively invalidated. v4 scopes `gateEvidence` to the active work item, adds `evidenceCoverage` and `gateExceptions`, and retires `changeHistory`.

stateVersion.description: Present on v2/v3/v4 documents. Redundant with version for tooling that reads stateVersion first.

trackingMode.description: How work is tracked. markdown: epic/story markdown files in directories. github: GitHub Projects/Issues for story tracking.

learnerTier.description: Resolved learner tier for this session

currentPhase.description: Current SDLC phase. The review phase is a mandatory gate between implementation and validation — it cannot be skipped.

epics.description: Epic status keyed by epic directory name

stories.description: Story status keyed by story filename

gates.description: Mandatory hard gates that must be explicitly satisfied before phase transitions. In v2+ a gate may be `true` only when backed by fresh evidence in `gateEvidence`; `cadet-agent state validate` rejects unsupported claims. Reset when moving to a new work item.

codeReviewCompleted.description: Full 17-step code review per CodeReview.md completed for the current story/epic

testsPassed.description: All tests for the current work item pass (red/green cycle confirmed)

storyTrackingUpdated.description: Story and epic markdown files updated to reflect completion

compileCheckConfirmed.description: Unity compile confirmed — automated via Unity CLI, or a user manual-confirmation record

unityAnalyzerClean.description: Zero Unity analyzer diagnostics (UNT*) in changed files

acceptanceCriteriaValidated.description: Each Given/When/Then criterion validated against implementation

securityReviewPassed.description: No sensitive data, secrets, or security concerns identified

designArtifactSyncConfirmed.description: Requirements, technical design, project plan, and epics are mutually consistent

reachabilityAddressed.description: The story's declared reachability is honoured: witnessed, or deferred to a work item that exists and is not already done. Required on review→validation only when .cadet/harness.json sets reachability.enabled; verified with `cadet-agent harness verify-reachability`. Contract v6 §2.

gateEvidence.description: Live evidence records backing gate claims. In v4 this holds only the active work item's records — a closed work item's evidence lives in its commit trailers and `.cadet/archive/`, summarised by `evidenceCoverage`. See harness.schema.json#/$defs/evidence.

evidenceCoverage.description: v4: per-work-item summary of evidence that is no longer inline. Regenerable from git trailers via `coverageFromSealed`, and required for the framework to keep answering 'does every done story own evidence?' after compaction.

gateExceptions.description: v4: the canonical home for gate exceptions, which are live state (scoped and expiring) rather than history. v1-v3 documents carry them in `changeHistory` instead; both are read, so a document validates the same either way.

activeRunId.description: v2: the run currently in progress, or null.

activeWorkItem.description: v2: the epic/story whose gates and evidence are currently authoritative. In v4 it also decides what stays inline in `gateEvidence`.

lastTransition.description: v2: the most recent legal transition and the evidence that justified it.

spikes.description: Spike status keyed by spike ID

changeHistory.description: v1-v3 only: audit trail of state changes, including gate exceptions for those versions. A v4 document omits this field entirely — transitions live in `lastTransition` and the sealing commit, handoff prose in `.cadet/handoffs/`, and gate exceptions in `gateExceptions`. An empty array is not written for v4, because a field that exists invites being filled again.

category.description: v3: required on a gate-exception under strictClosure. Determines the default expiry window and whether closureReviewNote is required. Strict closure only.

reason.description: v3: why the exception was needed. Strict closure only.

closureReviewNote.description: v3: who accepted this exception and what would change that judgement. Required for categories that are not documentation-only. Strict closure only.

expiryExtendedReason.description: v3: required when the exception expires beyond its category default.
